title: Enforcement Appeals Specialist
description: Introduction to Role & Team Bumble Inc. is looking for an Enforcement Appeals Specialist to join our Trust Operations team. We are seeking a highly motivated, hands-on candidate who thrives in a cross-functional environment and is excited to support the evolution of our Trust Operations team. In this position, you will investigate and respond to members' appeals as a result of account restrictions and content moderation. You will help uphold Bumble Inc.’s Community Guidelines by reviewing and enforcing actions on violating accounts and content to maintain a safe and respectful environment. The ideal candidate is comfortable working with sensitive content, including child exploitation, graphic or physical sexual violence, suicide and self-harm, and other potentially distressing material. Trust and safety are embedded in Bumble Inc.’s mission of creating a world where all relationships are healthy and equitable. Our wider Trust organization includes centralized and dedicated teams focused on: Creating products and systems that proactively detect and prevent harm and promote healthy, kind relationships. Developing policies that govern and adjudicate responsible, safe, inclusive, and respectful behaviour and content across all Bumble Inc. platforms. Supporting members who experience safety incidents in a trauma-informed, empathetic manner. This role will be based in London, UK reporting to the Enforcement Appeals Manager. Please note: This position involves exposure to sensitive and graphic content, including but not limited to vulgar, violent, and sexual content. What You’ll Do Review and take action on members’ appeals for content removals, account bans, or other enforcement actions in a timely and accurate manner. Provide high-touch, trauma-informed safety support to members who have experienced safety incidents. Collaborate with internal teams, including Trust & Safety, Customer Experience, and Legal, to escalate and resolve complex safety cases. Help enforce Bumble Inc.’s policies by reviewing and processing accounts and content flagged for safety violations. Participate in on-call rotations, including nights, weekends, and holidays, as needed. About You Have 2–4 years of experience in a Trust & Safety, customer support, crisis response, or content moderation role, preferably in a high-risk or safety-focused environment. Have demonstrated ability to work with sensitive content and provide support in cases involving child exploitation, sexual violence, and self-harm. Have experience handling high-touch safety escalations, particularly those involving vulnerable individuals. Have excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, empathetic, and professional responses. Have experience collaborating with Business Process Outsourcers (BPOs) to ensure quality and consistency in safety-related workflows (preferred). Are able to work independently, prioritize urgent tasks, and make sound judgment calls under pressure. Have proficiency in Spanish, Portuguese, French, or another second language (preferred). Are passionate about Bumble’s mission and values. Are empathetic, resilient, and comfortable working in emotionally challenging situations. Have a strong understanding of online safety issues and best practices in Trust & Safety. Are detail-oriented and able to balance efficiency with thoughtful decision-making. Are comfortable working flexible hours to support global teams and participating in on-call shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays. Benefits & Perks Annual personal learning & development budget Private Medical Insurance (PMI) Private Dental Insurance Babylon Health app Mental health support Enhanced parental leave, including a highly competitive maternity package Unlimited PTO Subsidised gym membership ‘Double matched’ pension contributions up to 6% Premium App Access About Us Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). BFF is a friendship app where people in all stages of life can meet people nearby and create meaningful platonic connections and community based on shared interests. Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products. AI Fluency AI is important to us. We’re excited by people who are curious and experimental, and who think thoughtfully about how AI can amplify their impact and outcomes. We encourage you to use AI responsibly as you prepare your application. Please don’t use it to fabricate experiences or answer questions live in interviews. We care deeply about authenticity and want to understand your real skills, judgment and voice, because building a meaningful, genuine connection with you matters to us. Final Compensation Will be determined based on factors such as the selected candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, skill set, and other job-related considerations. Inclusion at Bumble Inc. Bumble Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and we strongly encourage people of all ages, color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non-binary people, veterans, parents, people with disabilities, and neurodivergent people to apply. We're happy to make any reasonable adjustments that will help you feel more confident throughout the process, please don't hesitate to let us know how we can help. In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example: she/her, he/him, they/them, etc). AI in Bumble Inc. Hiring At Bumble, we may use AI tools to support parts of our recruitment process — such as helping us record, transcribe, and summarize conversations, and supporting job alignment by comparing resumes and job descriptions to highlight skills and potential roles that may be a good match. These tools help us work more efficiently and stay focused on you during our conversations. Importantly, all hiring decisions are made by people. AI is used only to support our team’s efficiency and improve the candidate experience — not to evaluate or decide on your candidacy. Participation in AI-supported interviews and conversations is completely voluntary and will not impact your candidacy. If you’d prefer to opt out, simply let your recruiter or interviewer know at the start of a call, or anytime during the interview or conversation. Summaries and related data are retained only as long as needed in line with our internal data retention policies. If at any point you’d like a transcription or summary deleted, please contact your recruiter directly. Fraudulent Candidate Detection Our applicant tracking system analyzes signals relating to device, IP, email, and phone data associated with each application to protect applicants and our hiring process from fraudulent applications. These signals provide indicators for internal review only and do not constitute a definitive determination of identity or intent. No applicant is rejected, advanced, or otherwise affected based solely on this analysis without human review For further information on how we hold and manage your data, please refer to our Privacy Policy . title: Customer Success Associate
description: Orbital is the AI platform for real estate legal work. Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. It’s the infrastructure that powers everyday life and is the world's largest asset class. Yet behind every single deal, real estate and legal teams work hard to navigate decades-old complexity; manually connecting documents, hidden obligations, geo-spatial context, and multiple parties into a path forward. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual. Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate. A bit about us: 🚀 We’re building at the forefront of AI technology, without losing the deeply human expertise our clients depend on. 🏢 Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal-grade precision. 💰 We've just raised a $60m Series B, led by Brighton Park Capital, to accelerate our global expansion – $75m raised to date. 🤝 We're trusted by 5,000+ real estate professionals, spanning UK Magic Circle and US Am Law 100 firms, to household names like M&S. Leading firms like BCLP, Orrick, Goodwin, Womble Bond Dickinson and Clifford Chance rely on Orbital to remove the busywork, freeing legal and real estate teams to focus on sharp judgment, standout client service, and closing deals faster. 💡 Working at Orbital means joining a bold, ambitious team, with the trust to take ownership and make a real impact from day one. 🚀 Join the team transforming how real estate is transacted with AI Orbital is building the first AI platform purpose-built for real estate transactions. With $60m Series B funding and a rapidly expanding our US and UK customer base serving some of the most prestigious law firms, including across the AmLaw rankings, as well as in-house real estate teams, title companies, and other organisations involved in the transaction. 🌟 The Opportunity As our Customer Success Associate (Support), you will be the first point of contact for our customers, ensuring they get fast, expert answers and a seamless experience every day. This role is built for someone at the start of their career who is smart, fast, and hungry to grow. You will: Be the face of Orbital to our customers on a daily basis Own support channels and become deeply expert in our product Work alongside a Senior CSM across some of the most prestigious real estate legal practices and organisations in the US and UK. Build the communication instincts and commercial acumen to progress toward full account ownership This is a high-learning, high-exposure role with a direct path into Customer Success. Progression at Orbital can be vertical - into CSM and portfolio ownership — or diagonal into other high-growth functions as we scale. 🧠 What You’ll Do Manage the inbound support queue and own first response- speed and quality are both very important here Resolve customer queries accurately and promptly, escalating where needed Build deep product fluency and become an internal product expert Spot patterns and share structured feedback with Product and Engineering Be comfortable picking up the phone, not every problem gets solved over email Support Customer Adoption and Delivery Assist with onboarding sessions, training materials, and customer rollout initiatives Join client visits and build genuine familiarity with how our customers work — from law firm real estate practices to in-house legal teams and other participants in the transaction Develop Commercial and Domain Expertise Learn how SaaS renewals and expansions are run by sitting alongside a Senior CSM Observe and, over time, participate in executive-level conversations with senior legal stakeholders Build understanding of the real estate transaction lifecycle and how AI is transforming it Help Build and Scale the CS Function Contribute to scaled customer programmes — think webinars, user groups, product update communications, and onboarding initiatives designed to reach customers at volume Support customer events — from in-person roundtables with law firm partners to virtual deep-dives with in-house real estate teams — helping coordinate logistics, materials, and follow-through Use best-in-class AI tools creatively and intelligently — whether to draft customer communications, surface product insights, prepare briefing notes, or find smarter ways to do the work Help shape the playbooks, processes, and norms we're building from scratch — your ideas about how we do things will actually get heard and implemented Act as the connective tissue between our customers and Orbital’s Product, Engineering, and CS teams — making sure nothing falls through the cracks as we grow ✨ Who We’re Looking For We are open to a range of backgrounds. The common thread is: bright, proactive, and genuinely interested in real estate and AI. One of the following: Early-Career SaaS, Hypergrowth Tech or Real Estate Background If you’ve spent 1–2 years as a BDR, SDR, or junior CS hire at a hypergrowth SaaS or AI company and you’ve genuinely stood out we want to hear from you. 1–2 years of experience in a real estate-adjacent role whether in law, brokerage, transaction support, or CRE services. You understand how real estate deals work, you've handled complex documents, and you're used to operating in environments where the stakes are high and the people are demanding. Commercial real estate paralegal (property, title, or transactional) Research associate or operations coordinator in a CRE or legal environment Any role where you've worked closely with real estate attorneys or on real estate due diligence In All Cases, You Will Have: Exceptional written communication — clear, professional, and precise Fast response instincts — you treat a customer query as something to solve today, not tomorrow Confidence picking up the phone and speaking with senior professionals Intellectual curiosity — especially around AI (with evidenced usage) technology, and legal / real estate industries High ownership mentality — you don't wait to be told Comfort and credibility engaging with senior legal or real estate stakeholders Ambition to grow — you want to own accounts, not just support them 🔒 Security is everyone’s responsibility at Orbital. We ask all team members to follow our security policies, complete regular awareness training, and handle sensitive data with care in line with ISO 27001 standards. Spot something unusual? Reporting risks or incidents quickly helps us maintain the strong culture of security and compliance we all depend on. 💡 At Orbital, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially welcome applications from people who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, or if the right role isn’t listed yet, we’d still love to hear from you. 💰 This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting . Pay is based on several factors, which may include job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and business requirements. They are part of a global go-to-market team mandate, though individually will cover a specific, local region.  Clients may span across one or more business units and verticals. By working in partnership with direct account teams, they will jointly engage clients, foster the necessary relationships, position <em>in-depth</em> the specific product line, so as to provide compelling reasons for clients to adopt and grow the usage of the given product.  They understand the appropriate approach, the guardrails, and the steps needed to successfully adopt the product line, as clients deliver on their business objectives.</p> <p>The Solutions Architect (AI) is paired with an Account Executive aligned to the product line with specific targets accordingly. Together, they will devise and implement a strategy across their assigned set of accounts, develop presentations, demos and other assets and deliver them such that customers make an informed decision as they decide to adopt the product-line in a meaningful way.</p> <p><strong>The impact you will have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Provide technical leadership to guide strategic customers to successful implementations on big data projects, ranging from architectural design to data engineering to model deployment</li> <li>Collaborate with GTM leadership and account teams to design and execute high-impact engagement strategies and strategic sales plays across your territory, driving AI adoption </li> <li>As a trusted advisor, serve as an expert Solutions Architect building technical credibility with CAIOs, CDOs and CTOs to drive product adoption and vision.</li> <li>Enable clients at scale through workshops, POC execution, and developing customer-facing collateral that increases technical knowledge and demonstrates the value of the Databricks architecture for AI and agentic workflows.</li> <li>Lead the design and implementation of high-profile, high-value agentic AI use cases on Databricks, leveraging Databricks Agent Framework, AgentBricks, and other Databricks AI capabilities to accelerate production adoption and deliver measurable business outcomes.</li> <li>Drive agentic AI quality and production readiness by implementing robust evaluation and monitoring strategies using MLflow, LLM-as-a-judge, custom evaluation metrics, and tracing to continuously improve agent accuracy, reliability, and performance.</li> <li>Influence product roadmap by translating field-derived, data-driven insights into strategic recommendations for Product and Engineering teams.</li> <li>Handle the most complex technical challenges in this product line by acting as the tier-3 escalation point for the field, ensuring customer success in mission-critical use-cases.</li> <li>Establish and refine the sales qualification and POC intake process, ensuring well-scoped engagements that maximize customer success and minimize friction for R&D.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Competencies & Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years in a customer-facing, pre-sales or consulting role influencing technical executives, driving high-level ML/AI strategy and product adoption.</li> <li>Experience with design and implementation of production-grade ML and generative AI applications in customer or enterprise environments</li> <li>Hands-on experience designing, building, and deploying enterprise-grade agentic AI solutions, including RAG, tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, and autonomous workflows, ideally using Databricks Agent Framework and Agent Bricks.</li> <li>Strong understanding of agentic AI evaluation methodologies, including MLflow Tracing, LLM judges, custom scorers, and systematic approaches to measuring agent quality, reliability, and production performance.</li> <li>Deep familiarity with using frontier models (from providers such as Anthropic, OpenAI and Google Gemini), including deployment, optimisation and migration strategies as well as with machine learning, LLMs, and agentic AI workflows.</li> <li>Proficient in programming, debugging, and problem-solving using SQL, Python, Apache Spark, cloud platforms, and Lakehouse architectures and with AI tools.</li> <li>Experience collaborating with Global System Integrators (GSIs) and third-party consulting organizations to drive customer outcomes in AI.</li> <li>Hands-on experience building solutions within major public cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), with an understanding of cloud-native AI platforms</li> <li>Undergraduate degree (or higher) in a technical field such as Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Applied Mathematics, Engineering or similar.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. title: Senior Director Global, BI Services
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit  <a href="../5377643008/wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>At WPP, we’re constantly reinventing the future of creativity on an ever-broader canvas, bringing together unrivalled talent, resources and skills to provide an integrated offer of communications, experience, commerce and technology.</p> <p>Over the last decade, we have developed a dedicated global client practice with the mission of accelerating WPP’s impact for our largest clients by bringing them the best of WPP. Each team is custom-built around a client’s specific needs and challenges, providing easy access to the right capabilities. And that’s why we’ve built OpenDoor for Amazon.</p> <p>OpenDoor is a unique integration of the best of WPP and Amazon – building on their respective strengths and visions. Whether at WPP or at Amazon, every project is an OpenDoor on new possibilities. Anything and everything can be an opportunity for our people to drive impact – for them to innovate, learn, thrive, and occasionally fail too.</p> <p>The unique OpenDoor partnership model is built to deliver next level Productivity, fueled by our industry-leading approach to People, Platforms, and Process. OpenDoor spans across all WPP agencies and disciplines such as media, business consultancy, communications and brand strategy, tech and commerce, public relations, and production.</p> <p>OpenDoor’s values are built from Amazon’s own 16 Leadership Principles, and WPP’s core values of Open, Optimistic and Extraordinary. Together, when WPP’s Creative Transformation meets Amazon’s next-level customer centricity, our people come together to challenge and impact what’s done today and build a better future.</p> <p>By joining OpenDoor, not only are you joining a cross-function team partnering with one of WPP’s top five global clients, but you are also taking a step to challenge yourself and the world around you every day, working in the most unusual way on some of Earth’s most ambitious opportunities in marketing, tech, media, business, and creativity.</p> <p><strong>Sr. Director, Business Intelligence</strong></p> <p>In this high-profile and important role, you’ll be asked to take accountability for data and reporting solutions we develop and maintain for one of our most important clients. </p> <p>Leading a globally distributed team of technical reporting data specialists, you will be asked to design, implement, and deliver reporting and data provisioning solutions for digital and traditional media. You will be the voice of Amazon reporting and data needs within DTA, WPP’s Data, Technology and Analytics arm, borrowing from and contributing to the Amazon specific data provisioning and reporting product, structuring team staff and processes. You will be the expert clients go to when reporting and business intelligence requirements emerge or evolve. Most importantly, you must have the technical ability / agility to customize to ensure client and media teams get access to the right data and insights to make the most of our client’s media investments, and in turn ensure high client satisfaction. </p> <p>Reporting into DTA SVP for Global Reporting Services and the OpenDoor Global DTA Lead, you’ll also be asked to represent the needs of and solutions developed for the client in wider reporting initiatives, and influence the product vision and strategy within this space.</p> <ul> <li>Own reports and data provisioning solutions for the client, taking direct accountability for the quality of the team’s solutions, representing them to clients and working with media leadership to drive successful adoption</li> <li>Demonstrate firsthand understanding of client and media team needs, and lead Business Analysts in the translation of expressed needs into clear and structured requirements for engineers and BI developers</li> <li>Work with clients and media leadership to establish consensus on the prioritization of requirements for development, using your knowledge of requirements and the technical solution to steer the conversation</li> <li>Lead the design of technical solutions to meet requirements, including the scoping and estimation of work to develop</li> <li>Provide strategic coordination across disciplines on the Amazon account (Media, Measurement/Analytics, Data Excellence, Leadership)</li> <li>Hire, train, and mentor a team of data engineers and reporting specialists, ensuring they have the environment to deliver their best work</li> <li>Provide hands-on leadership, leaning in to support the team when needed, and driving continual improvement in the way we ingest, store, transform and visualize data</li> <li>Partner with Data Excellence, and Engineering as well as Measurement, Analytics and Investment leadership to ensure reporting solutions are incorporating best practice metrics to assess performance, which in turn link to client business goals</li> <li>Be the voice of the client within DTA reporting product and service steering groups, directly influencing the ongoing development of supporting data & technology infrastructure</li> <li>Provide support and training to users of reporting solutions, with the aim of empowering them to be more self-sufficient in overcoming these issues.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience as a business intelligence or reporting specialists, preferably at a media agency or related company (e.g. publisher, ad tech, client marketing org)</li> <li>Experience designing and developing intuitive data visualizations with business intelligence software (e.g. PowerBi, Tableau, Looker, Datastudio) that empower end users</li> <li>Strong knowledge of using data infrastructure and cloud data management technologies, as well as data prep and ETL processes, to deliver robust data infrastructure</li> <li>Experience with digital marketing platforms and the data they generate, in particular Google Marketing Platform, Facebook, Twitter etc. Knowledge of their API’s a plus.</li> <li>Experience with WPP Media’s DPAM process and OMS, with particular benefit coming from experience with Campaign Management (formerly Olive) and Campaign Governance (formerly OCTRA)</li> <li>Experience helping set clear strategy, designing technical solutions, proactively managing feature roadmaps, and organizing technical resources to deliver it</li> <li>Excellent and adaptable written and verbal communications style, being able to translate non-technical use cases into technical requirements</li> <li>Strong influencing skills, able to represent and defend your data solutions with senior clients</li> <li>An ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams, and directly influence others to drive adoption of solutions and overcome upstream barriers to implementation</li> <li>Experience leading, nurturing and coaching high-performing technical resources</li> <li>A passion for data excellence and integrity, and a commitment to supporting others and providing better solutions to support it.</li> </ul> <p>Desirable</p> <ul> <li>Specific experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS), in particular S3, RedShift, and DBT.</li> <li>A general understanding of how data is tracked and exchanged in the process of digital advertising (e.g. role of adservers and other third-party providers of campaign health performance metrics such as DoubleVerify)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. </p> <p>We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. </p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.  Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.</p> <p>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location</p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (<a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy)</a> for more information on how we process the information you provide.</p> <p> </p> <p>While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. </p> <p>

title: Director, Planning
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p></p> <p><strong>2020 - Director, Planning</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>Wavemaker positively provokes growth for clients by reshaping consumer decision-making and experiences through media, content, and technology. Our name is both our mission and our method. We do our best work for brave brands and people who relish being challenged to go further and faster, together.</p> <p>The planning team are the guardians of creating industry leading, unrivalled work at Wavemaker. We are central conduits to all specialists, striving to push boundaries and have a positive impact on consumers and brand.</p> <p> </p> <p>Wavemaker UK is looking for a <strong>Planning Director</strong> to join our growing planning team, to drive planning across specific clients and be a media planning expert.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>In this role, you will:</strong></p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Media planning craft:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop an advanced understanding of media channels, channel ecosystems and planning best practices.</li> <li>Start to translate strategic approach into planning practices for specific client briefs and pitches.</li> <li>Have an advanced understanding of Wavemakers’s Purchase Journey thinking and planning philosophy across all client work. Including being an expert in a broad set of internal tools, as well as external tools to build a deep understanding of the consumer, the client’s business and its specific opportunities.</li> <li>Have an expert overview of the media market landscape, trends and start to build media owner relationships.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Campaign management & effective communication:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Oversee campaign management, ensuring quality control and output is of the highest standard.</li> <li>Develop a skilled understand of commercial practises and of the wider agency.</li> <li>Build and maintain client and agency relationships at a mid-senior level, to ensure a comprehensive understanding of stakeholders and client business.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Comms planning and storytelling: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Own planning presentations including defining the inputs needed and working with the wider teams to compile work and meet deadlines.</li> <li>Lead brainstorm and idea creation for campaigns</li> <li>Start to independently problem solve, including integrating and questioning data and insights and find solutions based on knowledge and experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <p> </p> <p> <strong>Practice Area Knowledge -Skilled-</strong> Develops breadth and depth of industry understanding. Becomes confident using tools, technology, techniques and systems and is able to train others.</p> <p>Comfortable presenting both direct from platform (OS, Architect etc) and developing a story from data but delivered outside of platform (Telmar etc).</p> <p>Can confidently answer client questions and liaise with internal teams on best solutions to use.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Problem Solving – Skilled</strong> - Uses critical questioning and maintains a broad perspective when analyzing information to gain a deeper understanding of the problem and wider impact. Quickly generates appropriate solutions informed by previous experience. Understands how to resolve escalated issues and supports others to problem solve. Supports or leads troubleshooting communication for issues.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Stakeholder Relationships – Skilled</strong> - Has an expert knowledge of client and agency structures. Can identify key decision makers and understands their perspectives which is used to build relationships. Has strong knowledge of the client sector/industry which is shared to build strategies and plans. Identifies strategic issues and raises questions to help stakeholders explore and understand their wider business challenges. ​​​​​​​ Can easily suggest business solutions to match client/stakeholder needs and achieve objectives.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Effective Communication -Advanced-</strong> Leads the delivery of relevant and accurate information to drive maximum impact. Consistently delivers communications to influence and educate all levels of seniority, appropriately judging the demands of the situation. Creatively develops presentations and comms to help with the understanding/education of complex information. Guides others on the best practices and approaches for creating clear, concise and organized communication materials to convey plans in a user-friendly way.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Campaign Management – Advanced -</strong> Reviews the work of others to ensure accuracy and thoroughness objectives have been met; provides coaching on ways to improve work outputs.  Applies best practice to campaign management and acts as the escalation point for issues.  Provide actionable insights during mid and post campaign reports to improve in-flight optimizations and future campaign brief recommendations.  Oversees team members to discuss current projects, workload and activities prioritises resources accordingly.  Improves workload management by supporting other in setting priorities and by postponing less relevant work.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Compelling Storytelling – Skilled -</strong> Applies big picture thinking in work and proactively leverages an understanding of the organization and key industry trends.  Understand the different elements of responses.  Designs differentiated communications (content focus, style, presentation etc) for various internal and external audiences.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Ideas Creation – Advanced -</strong> Lead new projects/activities that can create ideas to deliver effective solutions to clients business objectives.  Ability to proactively generate ideas to provoke and deliver against broader business strategies.  Coaches other to gain new insights and view opportunities from different perspectives.  Championing an environment that fosters innovation by encouraging others to openly share and build on other’s new ideas, products and solutions</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Comms Planning – Skilled -</strong> Applies knowledge of client, audience, channel, market and category to effectively deliver compelling multi-media plans.  Translates learnings and trends to create marketing communication strategies that are effective with clear measurement.   Application of purchase journey thinking and visualization of how the media plan works channels.  Translation of strategic direction/platform/provocation into directional role for media, channel role and behaviour in channel.  Identifies and recommends budget shifts as campaign is in-flight where appropriate.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. </p> <p>We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. </p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. </p> <p><em>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location</em></p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (<a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy)</a> for more information on how we process the information you provide.</p> <p> </p> <p>While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. </p> <p>#LI-Promoted</p> <p></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Director, Data Strategy, UK (FTC)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>3363 - Director, Data Strategy, UK (FTC) </strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong> </p> <p>We are seeking a Director to join our Data Strategy team for our major UK telco client, BTEE. <br>The BTEE team (aka OpenConnect) is one of the largest UK client in the agency and the data work on the account is innovative and future-facing, with clients who are data savvy and champion our work across their business. <br>This role is focused on the Consumer side of the BT Group business and will work across three of BT Group’s sub-brands; BT, EE and Plusnet.</p> <p>Data Strategy involves transforming the way our clients think about, organize and orchestrate data & technology to deliver more timely, engaging and meaningful brand experience for their customers. </p> <p>BT Consumer is a data rich client and that combined with clients willingness to test and evolve makes for opportunities to do agency leading work. Work is recognised by awards, agency-first’s and also TelCo-firsts for the EMEA market. This role will be part of an agency-team-wide-push to adopt AI and drive innovation to drive client outcomes.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>The main focus area of this role are as below;</strong></p> <p><br><strong>Data-led audience and bidding strategy enablement;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Using the data-sets and technology available to BTEE, lead and oversee the delivery of test, trial and strategy recommendations across paid media campaigns on addressable channels.</li> <li>Working closely with the Transformation lead and ensuring broader strategic workstreams and acceleration projects find a place in campaign activity and are set up in a way that's measurable and methodical.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>Technology Project Ownership;</strong></p> <ul> <li>As part of the BTEE’s Media Acceleration Roadmap, you will own broader workstreams to drive outcomes across DPAM use-cases, including the clients roadmap with Amazon Marketing Cloud.</li> <li>You will be part of wider workstreams that bring together the power of WPP as a group, which for example could include working with parts of the business beyond WPP Media, in order to bring new exciting projects to BT.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-functional Collaboration;</strong></p> <ul> <li>You will be in charge of Open Connect’s paid media Audience Approach and Audience Playbook, ensuring this stays up to date. </li> <li>Maintaining and improving Data Strategy ways of working in the campaign cycle with other internal agency practices on the BT account.</li> <li>Be a conduit between technical and less technical teams within the agency, ensuring alignment on project goals and client objectives and speaking in the correct data language to the clients.</li> <li>Work with the client and embedded agency teams to define, justify and request future signals and data products which can drive the clients business goals. This includes our internal Tech & AI Consulting team and the embedded engineering team at BTEE who build data products for us.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>This role sits in the Operations Pod of the team, alongside a Data Strategy Associate Director, Data Strategy Manager and a Data Strategy Associate.</li> <li>Each team member will own the Data Strategy for a specific product vertical but you will lead this Pod. You will need to ensure they are producing high quality work and look to unblock any challenges they have.</li> </ul> <p><br><br></p> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <p> </p> <ul> <li>Deep interest in Media & Technology: An understanding of and desire to learn more about data products, AI, technology, and trends within the advertising and marketing industry with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Customer Focus: A relentless focus on client success, with a passion for delivering exceptional client experiences and driving long-term relationships.</li> <li>Communication and Presentation Skills: Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, as this role hinges on effective interaction with clients and agency partners.</li> <li>Experience managing multiple stakeholders in a matrixed environment</li> <li>6+ years digital agency-side working on a data-led role either agency, vendor or client side, with a strong emphasis on digital paid media.</li> <li>Highly developed interpersonal, team building and relationship management skills</li> <li>TelCo experience preferable but not required</li> <li>Understanding of the importance of privacy first media and what that means for how we need to do things differently</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. </p> <p>We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. </p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. Translate multi-entity, multi-currency, consolidation, revenue recognition and statutory reporting requirements into how Light handles them, and say clearly where it doesn't yet. Enable partners to sell and deliver Light. Build demo environments, playbooks, reference architectures and certification content so partner teams can run Light without us in the room. Hands-on experience with at least one major ERP (NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics or Workday) and real implementation projects: data migration, integrations, APIs. A track record of running structured evaluations, RFPs or proofs of concept with large or demanding buyers, and winning them. Executive presence and crisp writing. You make complex things simple, in a demo, a workshop or a one-page readout. Genuinely AI-native. You've changed how you work because of AI tooling, not just added it to your workflow. Bonus points Ex-Big 4 (advisory or audit) and a qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CPA or equivalent). Experience in a partner or alliances SE role, building channel enablement programs. Exposure to IFRS and local GAAP across several European markets, and SOC 2 / ISO 27001 security reviews. You've configured AI agents in production or built your own tools with them. Probably not for you if: you've used ChatGPT once and weren't impressed, or you prefer a polished demo script to a hard question from an auditor. title: Growth Marketing Manager
description: Growth Marketing Manager Retire the ERP Light exists to replace factory-era ERPs with software that feels alive. Our Smart Financial Platform gives modern, global companies superpowers - automated accounting, real-time reporting, and financial flows that move at the speed of the business. We build with our customers, ship fast, and obsess over craft. In a short time, Light has gone from idea to the operating core for leading companies like Lovable, Legora, and Fuse Energy. We're an early team defining a new software category. Think engineers who love debits and credits, designers who care about reconciliation states, and operators who treat finance as a product. If you're excited to modernise how companies run money, you're in the right place. Backed by world-class investors including Balderton and Atomico and advised by industry titans, we're building category-defining products with the freedom to ship ambitiously and own outcomes. Come help us make Light the global default for next-gen finance. Finance deserves better Finance teams at fast-growing companies run global, real-time businesses on a patchwork of legacy ERPs and point solutions. Every new entity, market or tool adds another system to stitch together and another hire to keep the numbers reconciled. Light gives them a way out. We build the finance solution that lets finance teams have it all, through three parts that work as one: Our ledger records every transaction across every entity in real time, so the numbers hold up from day one. Our apps adapt Light to how each business runs, from procurement to billing to reporting. Our agents operate the repetitive work that used to need another hire, so finance teams spend their time on the decisions that matter. We take on the ERP and the legacy point solution world with something fast to implement, AI-native from the ground up, and better the more you use it. Today we run the finance function for companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot, with backing from Atomico, Balderton, Seedcamp, Cherry and Entrée, and teams across Copenhagen, London and Stockholm, with remotes world over. The Role We're looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to join our growth team and open up the channels we haven't really touched yet. We've built a lean, efficient demand generation engine on the core paid channels you'd expect at a Series A B2B company, with Google Ads and LinkedIn doing the heavy lifting. It works, and it fills our pipeline every month. Now we want to find the next sources of pipeline, and we need someone who knows how to build them from scratch. You'll work alongside our Senior Growth Marketing Manager, VP Marketing and the wider marketing team, with the freedom to test, learn and scale the channels that move the number. You'll sit close to sales, product and design, and you'll own the results of everything you launch. We may hire more than one person through this process, so if you go deep on some of these channels rather than all of them, we still want to hear from you. What You'll Be Doing Building a referral programme that turns happy customers, partners and finance leaders into a steady source of pipeline. Running G2 and Capterra campaigns that put Light in front of buyers at the moment they compare options, and turning our reviews into proof across every channel. Launching and scaling Meta Ads for B2B, testing creative and audiences until you find what drives qualified pipeline. Finding the creators and influencers finance teams follow, writing briefs that land and scaling their content into campaigns that drive pipeline. Growing our presence across search and AI answer engines, so that when a finance leader asks Google or ChatGPT about ERP alternatives, Light shows up. Setting up measurement for each new channel with RevOps, so we know what every dollar returns. Sharing what you learn with the team, doubling down on what works and cutting what doesn't. What We Think* You'll Need Enough years in growth to know how to take a channel from zero to pipeline at a fast-growing B2B SaaS company. Hands-on experience across referrals, review sites, Meta Ads, influencer marketing or SEO and GEO. We don't expect you to master all five, so show us where you go deep. A test-and-learn mindset, with the discipline to measure every experiment against pipeline and revenue. Comfort with numbers and tools, from ad platforms to HubSpot to spreadsheets. An eye for creative and a feel for what makes finance people stop scrolling. Deep curiosity about how AI is reshaping marketing, finance and the companies we serve. A can-do, empathetic and collaborative spirit. No brilliant assholes here, please. *If the core of the role sounds compelling but you don't tick every box, we'd still love for you to reach out and convince us you're the right person. The Good Stuff A five-day, in-office culture with a high-density team in Copenhagen. A competitive salary and potential stock options. 25 days of annual leave plus public holidays in the country where you're based. Regular socials and two company offsites a year. The chance to build new growth channels from the ground up at a company defining a new category. Light is an equal opportunity employer. The Famous Last Words We've proven the core of our growth engine works. Now we want to see how far it can go, and we want you to build the parts we haven't tried yet. If you love starting channels from scratch and watching them turn into pipeline, let's talk. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. 🔍 The Interview Process: Our process is clear and respectful of your time: Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins) Competency Interviews (Programming in Python and MLE domain interview) Deep-dive technical interviews (systems design and hiring manager interview) Final interview : mission & values alignment. We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability. Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you. At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law. For more information visit Careers at Wayve. title: Staff Engineer, EU Infrastructure
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><h2>About the Team</h2> <p>Our Infrastructure teams build the foundation that engineers at Wolt, Deliveroo, and DoorDash build on: the compute, cloud, and networking capabilities that enable Engineering teams to develop, deploy, and run services at global scale. The EU Compute team has a specific focus on provisioning, scaling, and the efficient operation of GPU infrastructure for AI and ML workloads. This is an emerging space with plenty of greenfield opportunities.</p> <p>We're looking for a Staff Engineer to be a hands-on technical leader for this infrastructure work that crosses team and brand boundaries. You'll set direction for the platform, turn complex problems into deliverable plans, write and review production code, and help other engineers make sound decisions. It's an exciting time to join: we're building a global platform and the choices made now will shape how engineers across the company ship for years.</p> <h2>What you’ll be doing</h2> <p>You'll own some of the hardest infrastructure problems in the company and make the platform easier to operate and safer to build on. We’re determined to build great platform products and user experiences, and you’ll be pivotal in making this reality.</p> <h3>Day-to-day in this role you’ll:</h3> <ul> <li>Set technical direction for shared AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure, balancing reliability, security, developer experience, and cost.</li> <li>Lead substantial initiatives from design through rollout and operation, coordinating dependencies and decisions across Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash, focusing on workloads targeting GPUs.</li> <li>Evolve Kubernetes clusters, cloud networking, identity, and infrastructure provisioning to support growing and varied workloads.</li> <li>Build reusable Terraform patterns and self-service tooling that help teams provision infrastructure safely and consistently.</li> <li>Improve deployment and operational practices, including GitOps, observability, capacity planning, incident response and recovery.</li> <li>Use production signals and developer feedback to find platform friction, choose where to invest and measure whether changes actually help.</li> <li>Assist with supporting the platform, with deep focus on GPU infrastructure, as well as broad focus on compute in general.</li> <li>Gracefully sunset legacy infrastructure and tooling, and create strategies to reduce toil.</li> <li>Mentor engineers through design reviews, implementation and incidents, raising the quality of infrastructure work across teams.</li> </ul> <h2>Our humble expectations</h2> <ul> <li>Deep experience building and operating Kubernetes and AWS infrastructure in production. Familiarity with GPU workloads and orchestration is a plus.</li> <li>Strong software engineering skills: you use Go, Python or a similar language to build maintainable tools and automation.</li> <li>Experience with infrastructure as code (we use Terraform) and with designing systems that other engineering teams depend on.</li> <li>A track record of leading complex technical work across teams, including architectural decisions, delivery, and operational follow-through. You have the breadth to collaborate and design across team and domain boundaries, and the depth to have hands-on impact.</li> <li>Strong judgment on trade-offs in distributed systems, networking, security, reliability, and cloud cost.</li> <li>Clear communication, and the ability to bring people together around a practical technical direction.</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Scope and influence.</strong> Shape infrastructure used globally, while staying close to the engineering. Your work will help product teams ship services with greater ease and confidence.</li> <li><strong>Real problems at global scale.</strong> Multi-cluster Kubernetes, AI / ML workloads, cloud networking, GitOps, and progressive delivery across a global company.</li> <li><strong>Autonomy and ownership.</strong> Set direction and see it through from design to operation, with the backing of a global engineering organisation spanning Europe and the US.</li> <li><strong>Growth.</strong> Room to expand your scope, whether through deeper technical leadership or broader cross-domain influence.</li> <li><strong>Great people.</strong> Work with talented engineers and leaders in a diverse, international environment, mentoring and learning from others.</li> </ul> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/GoL541_xj9w" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. title: Security Engineer III - Detection & Response
description: An Introduction to Primer Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform. Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on. Watch our showcase > Read up on our $100m Series C Learn more about our culture > Primer processes payments for some of the world's best companies, which makes us an attractive target and means getting detection and response right really matters. We're looking for a Security Engineer to join our Detection & Response function and own a meaningful slice of how we detect, investigate and respond to threats across our cloud infrastructure and SaaS estate. You'll write and tune the detections in our SIEM, build the automation that speeds up how we react, and be a first responder when something looks wrong. You'll have real ownership of the areas you work on, and the freedom to shape how we detect and respond to threats across them. You'll also work closely with our Application Security/Product Security engineers: what we learn from detections and incidents shapes how we build, and what they know about our products shapes what we look for. What you'll be doing Detection Build, tune and maintain detections in our SIEM (Elastic), and identify opportunities to onboard new log sources (e.g. AWS, Google Workspace, Kubernetes) and build new detections on top of them. Find what our current detections miss, and keep the rule set lean by removing what no longer adds value. Use Python and Terraform to build and maintain the infrastructure behind your detections and tooling. Response Own investigation: triage, investigate, escalate and resolve security incidents, and write up findings clearly enough to stand on their own Lead routine incidents end to end, and take a clear role in larger ones, whether that's driving the investigation or keeping stakeholders informed Build runbooks and automations (Python, Tines or similar) to cut manual work out of triage and response Join our on-call rotation for incident response and monitoring Across both Make and document risk decisions in your area, and know when to pull in others. Keep the controls you own audit-ready and contribute evidence for audits (e.g. SOC 2, PCI DSS). Use AI tools to work faster across detection and response, from drafting rules and queries to summarising investigations, while maintaining a healthy level of scepticism. What we're looking for Real experience responding to security incidents, from first alert through to write-up Hands-on experience writing and tuning detections in a SIEM (Elastic, Splunk or similar), using frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK to reason about coverage Experience with cloud-native detection and response in AWS or Google Cloud Comfortable with Python or Go for scripting and automation Clear, structured written communication, including under pressure Nice to have Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code Experience with no-code security automation or SOAR-style tooling Exposure to compliance frameworks like PCI DSS, SOC 2 or ISO27001 Background in fintech, payments or another regulated industry Experience using AI tools or agents in security work, and a clear view of where they help and where they don't ✅ A typical interview process An initial intro call with a Talent Partner An interview with the Hiring Manager Challenge Stage - Contextualised to the role A final, values-alignment interview What's the culture like at Primer? You'll be working with people who are mission-driven, smart, and reflective, and who are genuinely invested in building exceptional products and delivering success for our merchants. We work remotely, and have done since day one. We believe that building a successful, profitable company goes beyond proximity. We invest in our relationships through great remote working practices and thoughtfully designed face-to-face time, including workations, our annual company retreat, and access to co-working spaces across most major cities. title: Senior Director, Enterprise Risk Management
description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. About the team The Global Risk team at Airwallex plays a critical role in enabling the company’s growth by building a strong, scalable, and globally consistent approach to risk management. The team works across the business to define risk appetite, develop frameworks and policies, support strategic decision-making, and provide oversight of key risks as Airwallex expands across products, markets, and regulatory environments. You’ll be part of a highly collaborative group that partners closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Commercial, Financial Crime Compliance, Regulatory Compliance, and Legal teams to help Airwallex grow responsibly and with confidence. This is a team where you’ll tackle complex, high-impact challenges, shape how risk is managed at a global fintech, and help build the foundations for long-term scale. What you'll do As Senior Director, Enterprise Risk Management, you will shape and scale Airwallex’s enterprise risk management capability across the US and EMEA, helping ensure risk management is a strategic enabler of growth rather than a check-the-box exercise. You will translate Board-approved risk appetite into practical decision-making, strengthen governance and reporting, guide major product and organization changes, and help the company stay resilient as it grows across markets, products, and regulatory environments. You will work closely with the Chief Regulatory and Compliance Officer and senior leaders across the business to turn complex risk signals into clear action, while building a strong and practical risk culture across the organization. This role is based in the US or EMEA. Responsibilities: Lead the evolution of Airwallex’s enterprise risk architecture, including risk appetite, taxonomy, governance standards, escalation protocols, and enterprise-wide oversight, ensuring the framework remains aligned with business strategy and global growth priorities. Translate complex risk data, issues, and trends into clear, decision-useful reporting for the C-suite, Board committees, and external stakeholders, and act as a trusted independent advisor who can challenge initiatives that exceed approved risk appetite or outpace control maturity. Oversee risk-informed change governance for new products, new markets, major systems changes, and structural changes, ensuring governance supports business velocity while maintaining effective control standards and clear accountability for remediation of material issues. Own and continue to strengthen the enterprise crisis management framework, including escalation triggers, governance, and executive response mechanisms, while improving preparedness for severe but plausible events across operational, regulatory, technology, and business domains. Drive a unified, risk-aware culture across the organisation by championing consistent adoption of enterprise risk standards, reinforcing first line ownership, and promoting risk management as a shared responsibility and competitive advantage. Build and lead a high-performing global second line team, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Commercial, Compliance, Legal, Treasury, Finance, and regional leadership to support Airwallex’s next phase of scale with more data-driven and technology-enabled risk oversight. Who you are We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory. Minimum qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Law, STEM, or another relevant quantitative field. 10 to 15+ years of experience in risk management, operational risk, enterprise risk, compliance, controls, or audit within financial services, fintech, payments, banking, or another highly regulated environment. At least 5+ years leading enterprise risk management, operational risk, or governance programmes in a complex, matrixed, multi-jurisdiction organisation. Proven experience designing, building, or scaling second line of defense frameworks, including risk appetite statements, risk taxonomies, governance processes, and escalation mechanisms. Strong familiarity with the regulatory environment relevant to electronic money institutions and payments firms, including practical exposure to regulators such as the FCA, DNB, Bank of Lithuania, MAS, and FinCEN. Demonstrated experience preparing risk papers and communicating effectively with senior executives, Board or committee audiences, regulators, or auditors, with excellent written and verbal communication skills. Experience defining crisis or incident governance frameworks and leading or supporting executive-level response to material operational, regulatory, or business events. A high-ownership, pragmatic approach, with the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities and significant cross-functional collaboration. Preferred qualifications: Advanced degree such as an MBA, Master’s in Risk Management, or JD. Professional certification such as FRM, PRM, CRMA, CAMS, or CFE. Deep fintech and payments experience, including exposure to cross-border payments, merchant acquiring, card scheme environments, local payment methods, or multi-entity regulated groups. Experience managing risk approvals and governance in a high-velocity product and engineering environment, where new features, products, markets, or operating models are launched frequently. Strong data literacy and comfort using dashboards, metrics, and technology-enabled tools to support risk oversight and reporting. A clear bias toward automation, AI, and scalable tooling to improve issue management, reporting, and second line efficiency, paired with the judgment to balance innovation, business agility, and control effectiveness. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform.</p> <p>This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform.
